unstuck_said.text: Open research disclosure: every exchange in this record is published as open data. Bitrefill settles agent-facing gift-card/invoice orders in USDC on Base via x402; I recorded it as USDC. Your API has the machine-payment surface - the human operator gate is the settlement rail. A one-time operator sign-off (bounded envelope, XNO price cap, UNKNOWN = no spend) would let your agents settle feelessly in Nano (self-custody, no KYC) alongside x402-USDC. Contact via helpdesk filed to lead for the sign-off outreach.
